Description: Static clay-styled HTML wireframe approved before any app code.
Vite, React, TS, Tailwind, design tokens, base components, deploy.
Supabase project, schema, row-level security, parent signup and login, parent PIN.
Kid profiles with avatar and PIN, profile picker, kid-only routing.
One-time code or QR links a kid's own device; parent can revoke.
Integer ledger; parent awards or deducts with a reason; kid sees balance and history.
Parent manages prizes; kid browses by category.
Kid buys prizes with overspend protection; parent fulfils.
Kid saves toward a prize in a jar with a progress bar.
Loan requests, approval, weekly simple interest, repayment.
Per-child metrics, detail view, approvals inbox.

Summary: M11 Conversation prompts lessons and polish
Description: Parent prompt cards, mini-lessons, animations, empty and error states.
Keep-alive, export, security audit, accessibility, final deploy.

Summary: Build wireframe of kid and parent screens
Description: One static HTML file in clay style showing kid home, kid shop, kid loans, parent dashboard, child detail. Acceptance: file opens in a browser and shows all five screens.
Owner reviews, requests changes, approves. Acceptance: written approval recorded; gate for M1.

Summary: Project setup tooling and design tokens
Description: Vite, React, TS, Tailwind, Motion, Vitest; lint, typecheck and test scripts; tokens file for colors, shadows, radii, font. Acceptance: dev, build, test, lint all run clean.

Summary: Base clay components and showcase page
Description: ClayCard, ClayButton, ClayInput, ProgressBar, Tag, Avatar, Modal plus showcase page. Acceptance: showcase renders at desktop and narrow widths.

Summary: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages and update CLAUDE.md
Description: Connect repo, deploy on push, replace planned commands in CLAUDE.md with real ones. Acceptance: showcase live at public URL.
Tables for families, parents, kid profiles with RLS by family. Acceptance: a second family account cannot read the first family's data.

Summary: Parent signup login and PIN gate
Description: Email and password auth, protected routes, parent PIN to enter parent view. Acceptance: sign up, log in, and PIN gate work.
Create, edit, delete kid profile with name, avatar, PIN. Acceptance: profiles persist and only the owning family sees them.

Summary: Profile picker PIN entry and kid-only routing
Description: Avatar picker, PIN entry with attempt limit and lockout, kid routes only. Acceptance: kid session cannot reach parent routes or data.
Edge functions: one-time code (about 10 min, single use) and exchange for kid-scoped session. Acceptance: code works once and expires.

Summary: Link screens device list and revoke
Description: Parent shows code and QR, kid enters code, parent sees linked devices and revokes. Optional per-kid PIN lock. Acceptance: revoked device loses access.

Summary: Ledger schema balance logic and tests
Description: Integer ledger table, balance function, RLS (kids read only). Acceptance: unit tests pass; balance equals ledger sum; kid cannot write.

Summary: Parent award and deduct and kid balance and history
Description: Parent form with required reason; kid sees balance and history. Acceptance: award appears in kid history and updates balance.
Add, edit, remove prizes with name, price, category, image. Acceptance: changes persist.
Browse prizes with category filter and detail view. Acceptance: parent changes appear for the kid.
Purchase and ledger entry in one transaction. Acceptance: insufficient balance is blocked; concurrent buys cannot overdraw.
Parent sees pending purchases and marks fulfilled. Acceptance: status updates and shows in kid history.

Summary: Goals and jar logic with tests
Description: Schema and logic for goals and jar balance. Acceptance: unit tests pass; jar reconciles with ledger.

Summary: Goal and jar UI and goal reached
Description: Pick prize goal, move bucks in and out, progress bar, goal reached state. Acceptance: reaching target unlocks buying.

Summary: Loan rules request and approve or deny
Description: Parent sets rate and limit; kid requests; parent approves or denies. Acceptance: approved loan credits the kid's balance.

Summary: Interest calculation and weekly accrual job
Description: Simple weekly interest on principal via scheduled job. Acceptance: unit tests pass; job accrues on schedule.
Kid sees owed, rate, next interest; repays; loan closes at zero. Acceptance: repayment clears the loan.

Summary: Child summary cards and detail view
Description: Card per child (balance, savings, loan owed) with drill-down and activity timeline. Acceptance: multi-kid numbers correct.
Loans and purchases awaiting parent action in one list. Acceptance: acting on an item removes it.
Event-based prompt cards for parents; lessons on first borrow and first save. Acceptance: prompts fire on the right events.

Summary: Animations and empty and error states
Description: Squish buttons, balance count-up, goal confetti, empty and error states. Acceptance: each state is reachable and looks right.
Daily GitHub Actions ping to Supabase; data export script. Acceptance: ping runs daily; export produces a full backup.
Two-family RLS test across all tables; keyboard, contrast and label checks. Acceptance: no cross-family access; checks pass.
Production deploy and end-to-end walkthrough. Acceptance: all milestones' verify steps pass on the live site.
